overview.name: Canary Staked SUI ETF
overview.description: In seeking to achieve its investment objectives, the Trust will hold SUI and establish its net asset value by reference to the CoinDesk Sui CCIXber 60m New York Rate. The Pricing Benchmark is calculated by CoinDesk Indices based on a 60-minute time-weighted average price of the SUI-USD CCIXber Reference Rate, which is an aggregation of executed trade flow of major SUI trading platforms.
